# CardAction

Figma: [07c. CardAction](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-944) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

Actionable cards: a compact ActionTile (icon + label quick-action) and a larger ActionPrompt (icon + title + description + CTA). LTR/RTL, tokenized, built from a shared Label atom + Syntropy icons + Button.

### CardAction / Label

Title plus optional supporting info text atom shared by ActionTile and ActionPrompt.

Level: atom · Part of: ActionTile, ActionPrompt

Use when:
- Text inside ActionTile (Size=sm) or ActionPrompt (Size=md)

Don't use when:
- List row text: use Content
- CardInfo text: use CardInfo / Content

Accessibility: Title forms the action's accessible name; keep info short.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Title | `title` | text |  | Action title |
| Info | `info` | text |  | Short supporting info |
| Show info | `showInfo` | boolean |  | true |
| Size | `size` | variant | sm, md | sm |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

### ActionTile

Compact quick-action tile (icon plus short label) for dashboard shortcut grids or as a horizontal row with supporting info, with Default, Selected and Disabled states.

Level: organism · Contains: CardAction / Label

Use when:
- Home quick actions grid such as Deposit, Withdraw, Statements (Style=Vertical)
- Shortcut rows with one-line info (Style=Horizontal)
- Choosing one option among tiles (State=Selected)

Don't use when:
- A nudge with description and a button: use ActionPrompt
- Settings rows grouped in a card: use ListItem inside ActionList
- Informational guidance: use CardInfo
- Deals: use CardDeal

Accessibility: Button or link role named by the label; Selected exposed via aria-pressed or aria-checked, not tint alone; icon decorative.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Icon | `icon` | instance swap | default Icon / wallet | 3135:726 |
| Size | `size` | variant | Small, Default | Small |
| Style | `style` | variant | Vertical, Horizontal | Vertical |
| State | `state` | variant | Default, Selected, Disabled | Default |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

### ActionPrompt

Larger CTA card with an icon badge, title, description and a Button that nudges the user to one action, such as completing verification, toned by priority.

Level: organism · Contains: CardAction / Label, Button

Use when:
- Must-do tasks such as completing KYC or adding a bank account (Tone=Warning)
- Brand nudges such as enabling notifications (Tone=Brand)
- Confirming completion with a next step (Tone=Success)

Don't use when:
- Simple shortcuts: use ActionTile
- Information without a button: use CardInfo
- Severity or system messages: use Alert or Banner
- Goal setup: use GoalActivate

Accessibility: Button label states the action; tone conveyed by text, not icon colour only.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Icon | `icon` | instance swap | default Icon / shield-check | 3137:816 |
| Tone | `tone` | variant | Neutral, Brand, Warning, Success | Neutral |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

CardAction presents a single action. Use ActionTile for dashboard quick-action grids and shortcut rows (icon + label, with selected/disabled states); use ActionPrompt for larger nudges with a title, description and a CTA button (e.g. “Complete your verification”). Both ship LTR + RTL.

### Atomic architecture

Both organisms compose a shared CardAction / Label atom (title + optional info) with a swappable Syntropy Icon; ActionPrompt also reuses the Button. The Label carries the content - no raw text in the organisms.

Label (atom)

Button (reused)

Icon (swap)

### Components

ActionTile is a compact quick-action (icon + label) as a vertical tile or horizontal row; ActionPrompt is a larger CTA card with title, description and a button.

ActionTile · tile

ActionTile · row

ActionPrompt

### Sizes

Two sizes - Small (legacy-compact, for dense grids) and Default - across both tile and row styles.

### States

ActionTile carries Default, Selected (active/brand-tinted) and Disabled (unavailable).

Both organisms mirror: layout flips, text right-aligns, Arabic content, the arrowhead points inward.

### Code examples

Flutter usage of both organisms.

### ActionTile (quick-action)

```dart
SafqahActionTile(
  style: ActionTileStyle.vertical,
  size: ActionTileSize.small,
  icon: SafqahIcons.wallet,
  label: 'Fund',
  selected: false,
  onTap: () => context.push('/wallet/fund'),
)
```

### ActionPrompt (CTA)

```dart
SafqahActionPrompt(
  tone: ActionTone.warning,
  icon: SafqahIcons.shieldCheck,
  title: 'Complete your verification',
  description: 'Add your ID to unlock investing.',
  ctaLabel: 'Verify now',
  onPressed: () => context.push('/kyc'),
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Use ActionTile for dashboard quick-actions and shortcut rows - a short label, optionally a one-line subtitle.

Don’t

Don’t overload a tile with long copy or multiple actions - switch to ActionPrompt when you need a description + CTA.

Do

Use ActionPrompt tones to signal priority (warning for must-do, success for completed).

Don’t

Don’t convey Selected by the green tint alone - keep the label and an accessible selected state.
